question: Which of the following parts of the human body is / are NOT lined with squamous epithelium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kidney tubules**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kidney tubules** are not lined with squamous epithelium.
 
• Squamous epithelium is a type of epithelial tissue that consists of flat, scale-like cells.
 
• It is found lining surfaces such as the **mouth, skin, and oesophagus**, which are places where rapid diffusion or filtration is required.
 
• In contrast, the kidney tubules are lined with **cuboidal epithelium**, which is specialized for secretion and absorption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **cuboidal epithelium** consists of cube-shaped cells and is found in **glandular tissues** and in the lining of **kidney tubules**.
 
• Kidney tubules play a crucial role in the **filtration and reabsorption **processes of the kidney, helping to maintain the body's electrolyte balance and remove waste products.
 
• The presence of cuboidal epithelium allows for the efficient processing of filtrate and the selective reabsorption of essential substances.
 
• Understanding the specific types of epithelial tissue and their locations in the body is essential for comprehending their functions in different physiological processes.
